    # Four 4x4 panels are separated by vertical marker columns (3).
    # Overlay the panels, resolving overlaps by the color precedence observed:

    panels = [
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(4)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(5, 9)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(10, 14)] for r in range(4)],
        [[grid[r][c] for c in range(15, 19)] for r in range(4)],
    ]
    priority = (9, 4, 8, 5)
    out = []
    for r in range(4):
        row = []
        for c in range(4):
            present = {panel[r][c] for panel in panels}
            row.append(next((color for color in priority if color in present), 0))
        out.append(row)
    return out
